newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P assigns BTR Nylex MTNs A-plus rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns BTR Nylex MTNs A-plus rating.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Tuesday it has assigned its A-plus rating to BTR Nylex Ltd domestic A$500 million medium term note programme.
The notes will be issued in parcels of A$500,000 and represent unsecured obligations ranking equally with BTR Nylex's existing debt.
"BTR Nylex's rating reflects the implicit support of its UK-based parent company, BTR Plc (BTR) and its stand-alone credit quality," S&P said.
It said BTR Nylex had shown a relatively stable operating performance from leading market positions in diverse industrial manufacturing and engineering businesses.

BTR does not guarantee the subsidiary's debt. Both companies' ratings were downgraded in October 1996, reflecting the anticipated impact of restructuring on the group's earnings and balance sheet structure.

"BTR Nylex's strategic growth focus in diverse business in established and emerging markets, combined with Standard & Poor's expectation that the restructured BTR group will return to conservatively financing its group operations, provide ratings stability in the next two to three years," the rating agency said.
